positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed, maintained and enhanced features in Nimbo, an app that helps doctors and clinics administrate and run their businesses. Worked as a full-stack developer using Ruby on Rails and Ember JS. Developed with different agile methodologies, like scrum and shape-up cycles. Collaborated with other areas like product, design, and customer success, in a remote and a face-to-face modality.

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description: 12-week program that allows CS students to experience the roles of a program manager and software engineer. With a team of coworkers from different disciplines, we designed and developed a feature used for data visualization for power apps.

positions.title: Digital Intern
positions.description: Part of GE Summer Experience 2018, The project consisted of organizing and restructuring a Visual Basic code that generated process sheets for the manufacture process of gas turbine blades. A graphic interface was created for the data capture optimizing the process with a 75% reduction of the time (from 8 to 2 hours)
